# scutum_node (Resource)

Register a Scutum node (hub or remote).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scutum_node" "edge_eu_west" {
  name       = "edge-eu-west-1"
  type       = "remote"
  address    = "10.100.0.10/32"
  public_key = "Jk5Hf3zXqTvP2LmN9sKdWbYcEuRoAiQeGhVwMnBxOp0="
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) WireGuard mesh IP or CIDR for this node.
- `name` (String) Unique node name.
- `public_key` (String) WireGuard public key (base64).
- `type` (String) Node type: hub or remote.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node UUID assigned by Scutum.
